context: WWE's first-ever live TV from the Accor Arena; final leg of the 2026 European tour (special 2pm ET start). KOTR/QOTR R1 concludes; two title defenses (Sol Ruca + Penta both retain). Spine: (1) Jacob Fatu refuses Jey's order to attack Rollins ('I acknowledge Roman ONLY') — the augury fault-line widens; (2) Chad Gable's redemption pays its first physical dividend (returns Rey's stolen mask); (3) The Vision costs Rollins his KOTR run. Outlet-backfill (no live markers): WWE.com, F4W/WON, WrestlingInc, Slam, Bodyslam, Khelnow, 411mania. STRONG NEGATIVE FINDING: NO Bloodline+Judgment Day alliance / no Heyman reveal / no Rhea staredown on this show (verified absent across 7 sources; conflation with an Oct-2023 angle). FLAGS: 'Roman returns next week' Slam-only; Penta 619-first outlier; Bayley back-clap Slam-only.

segments.outcome: Oba Femi opened ('not a prediction, that's a spoiler'), referenced his 1-1 with Lesnar (snake/cheater). Dominik Mysterio interrupted ('King of the Luchadors,' 'respect the stache'); JD McDonagh chair-attacked Femi from behind -> Femi no-sold, threw Dom across the ring. Builds the KOTR semifinal Femi vs Dominik ('I'll introduce you to your Daddy').
segments.notes: Both men advanced previously -> this is SF build. Earned-ascent (Femi) vs inherited-name (Dom).

segments.outcome: Queen of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Liv Morgan def. Becky Lynch, Alexa Bliss & Chelsea Green via rollup on Green (her birthday). Liv ADVANCES. No interference.
segments.notes: Liv through to QOTR SF (vs Charlotte, who wins 6/12).

segments.outcome: Seth Rollins ('Monday Night Rollins') declared he's done with The Vision, wants to win KOTR and reclaim 'the title I never lost' — aiming at Roman Reigns / the WHC at SummerSlam. 'The Vision is in the past.'
segments.notes: Opens the explicit Rollins-vs-Roman SummerSlam build; the ejected founder turns his back fully on the Vision.

segments.outcome: Women's Intercontinental Championship: Sol Ruca (c) def. Lyra Valkyria via Sol Snatcher — RETAINED (1st successful defense). No interference. Pre-match Bayley hyped Lyra with a notably hard back-clap (foreshadow seed).
segments.notes: Closes the Ruca-vs-Lyra IC thread (paid off as a clean first defense). Bayley/Lyra tension seed simmers.

segments.outcome: Gable apologized to Penta for disrespecting lucha (called himself a coward). Penta accepted but said Gable must address 'who you have to talk to' (Rey).

Intercontinental Championship: Penta (c) def. Rey Mysterio via Mexican Destroyer — RETAINED (9th defense). POST-MATCH: Ethan Page & Rusev attacked both; Rusev applied the Accolade to Rey and RIPPED REY'S MASK OFF. Dragon Lee saved, was overwhelmed; Chad Gable ran in, cleared the heels, retrieved Rey's mask and handed it to Penta. Page demanded an IC rematch.
segments.notes: Closes the Rey-vs-Penta IC program (Rey loses his shot). Opens Page & Rusev vs the lucha bloc as the new IC direction. Gable's first physical redemption dividend: the man who STOLE a luchador's gimmick now PROTECTS a luchador's actual mask.

segments.outcome: Rey accepted Gable's apology but pointed further back: 'Look back a little further and you'd find something you might regret' (older Alpha Academy mask-disrespect history). Dragon Lee vouched for Gable.
segments.notes: Redemption chain, pt. 3 (Rey node) — the debt is older than this run.

segments.outcome: Locker-room: the Usos + Fatu confronted Rollins. When Rollins's criticism zeroed in specifically on Roman, JEY ORDERED FATU TO ATTACK ROLLINS — Fatu REFUSED, stared, walked off. In a follow-up, Fatu told the Usos he answers ONLY to Roman (the OTC), not them, and redirected them to LA Knight. Rollins laughed at the dysfunction.
segments.register: Aitu bound to the FATHER, not the family
segments.notes: THE augury fault-line, now textual — one week after the 'reunion.' Vertical loyalty (to the patriarch) over lateral (to the Usos): the precise crack that, per the standing augury, becomes the SS27 patricide-by-birthright. WWE.com headline: 'Jacob Fatu refuses to do The Usos' dirty work to Seth Rollins.'

segments.outcome: LA Knight: Roman keeps WWE 'trapped in the Bloodline vortex,' 'conned everyone,' his 'empire is crumbling'; 'I don't take orders from Reigns.' Jey interrupted ('stay in your lane'); Knight: 'Screw your family!' Jey went to attack, Jimmy held him back. Sets Jey vs LA Knight, KOTR (SD 6/12).
segments.notes: Opens the personal Jey/Knight feud feeding the 6/12 KOTR R1.

segments.outcome: Roxanne Perez floated a Liv-vs-Raquel QOTR final benefiting Judgment Day; Morgan pivoted to a plan to help Dom beat Femi. Dom & JD griped the Femi scheme failed. No formal alliance announced.
segments.notes: Judgment Day internal scheming continues — explicitly NOT a Bloodline alliance.

segments.outcome: Raquel touted her prior win over IYO and said she'd then go after Rhea's title (lone Rhea reference — name-drop, no appearance). IYO vowed to put Judgment Day in its place and become World Champ at SummerSlam. Sets the QOTR semifinal.
segments.notes: Opens the IYO vs Raquel QOTR SF (Raw 6/15).

segments.outcome: King of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Je'Von Evans def. Seth Rollins, Ricky Saints & Talla Tonga via OG Cutter on Saints. Decisive beat: Austin Theory pulled the ref/Rollins -> Montez Ford ran Theory off -> Bron Breakker speared Rollins, letting Evans steal it. The Vision COST Rollins his KOTR run. Evans ADVANCES.
segments.register: young-ascendant capitalizes on the giants' war
segments.notes: The Vision's warfare on Rollins is the headline angle; Evans the opportunist beneficiary (-> SF vs the 6/12 winner, Jey Uso).
